name: StalkChain Data
description: Connects AI assistants to live on-chain trader, wallet and token research through StalkChain's hosted MCP server and REST API.

skills.name: Research Tracked Traders
skills.description: Queries tracked-trader positions, trade history and performance so an assistant can investigate a trader's on-chain activity.

skills.name: Analyze Wallet Activity
skills.description: Looks up wallet balances, transfers and historical activity to support evidence-based research across supported chains.

skills.name: Investigate Token Risk
skills.description: Checks token holders, developer activity and available on-chain safety signals before a user acts on a trade idea.
